t: The $(item)Liquid Compressor/$ is a simple generator which can produce $(l:base_concepts/pressure)compressed air/$. It burns liquid fuels to do so; to see which fuels you can use and their effectiveness, open up the $(bold)Available Fuels/$ tab in the Liquid Compressor's GUI. Note that this also includes high-temperature fluids such as lava.
$(item)液体压缩机/$是一种简单的机器，可以产生$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压缩空气/$。它通过燃烧液体燃料来实现这一点；要查看你可以使用哪些燃料及其效果，请打开液体压缩机 GUI 中的$(bold)可用燃料/$选项卡。注意，这也包括诸如熔岩之类的高温流体。
